scope: Resolve all mechanical ambiguity cases from Step 1 using current official programme/institution sources. Registry identity only; no external-curriculum reconstruction or UCR comparison generation.
notable_normalization_patterns: Delivery mode, language, location and registration identity are not assumed to define separate academic counselor targets.
Current official evidence can merge several source rows/offerings into one academic target or split one source representation into several genuine student-facing targets.
Joint degrees offered across multiple institutions are normalized toward one academic target with all institutions retained.
Future/legacy RIO lifecycle markers are interpreted against current official admissions/programme evidence rather than treated mechanically as closure.
Free-registration or administrative variants do not create separate counselor targets when no distinct current student-facing programme identity exists.
Teach-out-only or no-longer-current identities remain auditable but are marked not production-eligible.
notes: The 83 decisions are case-level resolution instructions, not the final normalized counselor programme table.
Several cases overlap the same source rows or provisional target group; Step 3 must apply all decisions jointly rather than summing target_count.
The final counselor target count will be calculated only after Step 3 constructs the normalized target and crosswalk tables.
The original Pathways_programmes, programme_interests, source_rows.csv, offerings.csv and resolution_cases.csv remain unchanged.
